name: Everyday sneaker
blurb: The pair I reach for without thinking. Comfortable at hour ten, looks fine with everything.

name: Court pair
blurb: Pickup games and pickleball alike. Grippy enough to embarrass someone.

name: Post-run slides
blurb: Ugly on purpose. The first thing on after any long run, and I will not be shamed.

name: Off-road pair
blurb: Mud, roots, questionable shortcuts. Grips everything, apologizes for nothing.

name: Go-to runner
blurb: Cushioned enough for long miles, light enough that I don't blame the shoes.

name: Indoor trainer
blurb: Stable, quick, and made for the kind of session that runs longer than planned.

name: Foam runner
blurb: The answer for errand days when laces feel like an unnecessary negotiation.

name: Hiking shoe
blurb: A dependable companion for long trails, loose rock, and bad map decisions.

name: Retro pick
blurb: Older than some of my classmates. Still the best-looking thing on this shelf.

name: Terrace classic
blurb: Clean enough for dinner, durable enough for a day that wanders everywhere.

name: Winter boot
blurb: Waterproof, warm, and immune to salt stains. Built for a proper cold snap.

name: All-weather boot
blurb: For when the forecast looks hostile but the plan still sounds worth it.

name: Lifting shoe
blurb: Flat, stable, zero bounce. Squats feel honest in these.

name: Airport slip-on
blurb: Through security in four seconds. Comfort over dignity, always.

name: The grail pair
blurb: Too clean to wear, too good to sell. They live on the shelf and judge the others.

name: Camp mule
blurb: Easy around the campsite and forgiving after a day spent on your feet.

name: The beaters
blurb: Lawn mowing, painting, rain errands. Every good rotation needs a sacrifice.

name: Dress-adjacent pick
blurb: The one pair that survives weddings, interviews, and airport sprints alike.

name: Lounge pair
blurb: Soft, understated, and reserved for a quiet weekend with nowhere to be.

name: Ridge runner
blurb: Light enough to move quickly, rugged enough for whatever the path becomes.
